import re


def encode(s):
    """Run-length encode a string of letters.

    Each run of the same character becomes the character followed by its
    run length, omitted when the length is 1. e.g. 'aaabcc' -> 'a3bc2'.
    """
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        count = j - i
        out.append(s[i])
        if count > 1:
            out.append(str(count))
        i = j
    return ''.join(out)


def decode(s):
    """Inverse of encode. Handles run lengths with multiple digits."""
    out = []
    for match in re.finditer(r'([A-Za-z])(\d*)', s):
        ch, digits = match.group(1), match.group(2)
        count = int(digits) if digits else 1
        out.append(ch * count)
    return ''.join(out)
